summary: Exclude Qwen QSA scratch cache from Simple CPU offload
compatibility: Applies only when SimpleCPUOffloadConnector is enabled. The regular OffloadingConnector remains unqualified for this model.
details: The optional Simple CPU KV connector excludes non-prefix-cacheable QSA ring blocks from lazy target sizing, external load selection, and eager stores.
The change preserves the original author and code from vllm-project/vllm#55033.
